title: Operations Analyst, Market Data
why_fit: Data-licensing and usage-reporting operations that map to his Python reconciliation automation and Northrop controls work; requires 2+ years in financial-services operations.
why_us: Alpaca's market data product depends on accurate licensing records and monthly usage reports, and that is the kind of detail work I do well. At AMG Family Dental I automated a weekly insurance payment reconciliation in Python, cutting the process from 5 hours to 1 and flagging underpaid claims. At Northrop Grumman I audited 100+ financial models for accuracy, compliance and internal controls. Tracking renewal dates, matching usage to contract terms and finding ways to automate reporting is a direct extension of both. I also like that the role sits between sales, legal, finance and engineering.
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Operations Analyst, Market Data role at Alpaca. The job is about keeping licensing, usage reporting and entitlements accurate across many data sources and partners, and my background is built around that kind of recurring, detail-heavy work with money and contracts attached.

At AMG Family Dental in Belmont, MA, I run financial operations for a practice serving 1,000+ patients a year. One of my projects was a weekly insurance payment reconciliation that was taking about 5 hours by hand. I automated it with Python, brought it down to 1 hour, and had it flag underpaid claims for follow-up. Separately, improving reporting and reconciliation in Dentrix helped me identify and recover $500K+ in annual revenue. The lesson I took from both is that missed deadlines and unchecked records cost real money, which is exactly the risk your posting describes with data licenses and renewals.

At Northrop Grumman I audited 100+ financial models for accuracy, compliance and internal controls, and I tracked program costs in SAP and Deltek Cobra while keeping the data clean. That taught me to read terms carefully, document what I find and answer questions from people in other functions. The Alpaca role asks for the same habits when responding to data source audits and inquiries.

I hold an M.A. in International Economics and Finance (STEM) from Brandeis and a B.S. in Business Administration with a Finance major from Suffolk. I work comfortably in advanced Excel, SQL and Python, which fits the nice-to-have of scripting to automate licensing and reporting processes. I am a US citizen, fluent in English and Armenian, and available immediately.

I would welcome the chance to talk about how I can help keep Alpaca's market data business compliant and running smoothly.

Sincerely,
Alexander Airapetian

title: Associate Tax Analyst

why_us: This role keeps Fidelity's Corporate Tax Department organized, from invoices and purchase orders to tax notices that must reach the right person on time. That is close to my daily work at AMG Family Dental, where I handle billing, collections and revenue tracking and reduced A/R aging 10% by tightening claim submission and follow-up. I like roles where accuracy and deadlines matter and where advanced Excel carries the work, and the posting's mention of Power BI and Alteryx fits my interest in building better reporting. A large asset manager in Boston is also where I want to build my career.
cover_letter:

What I do bring is persistence, organization and real comfort talking about money, and I am looking for a structured SDR program where I can learn the craft from people who do it well.

I also reduced A/R aging 10% by streamlining claim submission and follow-up. 

Because I come from finance, I understand how buyers measure ROI, budgets and cost savings. Black Duck's customers have to weigh the cost of security tooling against the cost of risk, and I am used to building budgets, running variance analysis and presenting numbers so owners can decide. At Northrop Grumman I presented cost-saving recommendations to senior leadership, and at FYND in Tokyo I presented AI adoption recommendations to the co-founders.

I hold an M.A. in International Economics and Finance (STEM) from Brandeis and a B.S. in Business Administration from Suffolk, and I have about three years of professional experience including internships. I am a US citizen, fluent in English and Armenian, and available immediately.

Sincerely,
Alexander Airapetian
